name: Love In The Air
description: Rain plots to make Phayu fall for him to ruin his reputation, while Sky grapples with his feelings for Prapai, in this whirlwind of emotions and growing love.

videos.title: Special Episode
videos.overview: It's now the break between semesters for Rain and Sky and there are still a few things to work out in their new relationships. In fact, Rain and Sky have run off to a beach villa, instructing their boyfriends not to follow. The two juniors' possessiveness comes to a head.

videos.title: Not Just Rain, But A Raging Storm
videos.overview: When Rain has car trouble in the middle of a raging storm, a stranger named Payu stops to help him out. After their brief meeting Rain continues to think about the kindness of Payu until they meet once again.

videos.title: I Hate Payu (Storm) And I'm Not Talking About The Weather
videos.overview: In exchange for the repairs to his vehicle, Payu demands that Rain must speak politely to him from then on. However, after Payu's continued teasing, Rain makes a promise to get back at him by making Payu fall in love with him.

videos.title: I Like Rain And I'm Not Talking About The Weather
videos.overview: Rain begins his mission to make Payu fall in love with him, he starts by attempting to see Payu every single day. Payu comforts Rain after Rain accidentally overslept and missed his project deadline.

videos.title: Warm Me With Your Heart
videos.overview: Payu demands that Rain stop coming to the garage until he can prove that he is being responsible and balancing his studies.

videos.title: The Calm Before The Storm
videos.overview: Payu visits Rain at home while he recovers from a fever.  Rain opens up to his best friend Sky about his relationship with Payu.  Saifah encourages Payu to take Rain to one of the circuit races.

videos.title: The Near Raging Storm
videos.overview: Stop attends the street race, but his ego causes problems for the other racers and staff, including Payu.

videos.title: Sky After Rain
videos.overview: Payu discovers that Stop has abducted Rain and rushes to rescue him with the help of a friend.

videos.title: Not Just Wind, But A Typhoon
videos.overview: Sky is cornered by security at the street race, but Prapai steps in to pull him out of trouble... but not for free.

videos.title: Could You Be The Wind That Passes By?
videos.overview: Nightmares of his past keep Sky from sleeping, pushing him towards complete exhaustion.  When Prapai returns from a week of traveling, Sky's health has deteriorated to the point of collapsing.

videos.title: Could You Be The Sky That Becomes My Destination?
videos.overview: Prapai nurses Sky back to health after he falls ill.  Pai must prove to Sky that he isn't only interested in him for a sexual relationship

videos.title: The Sky Of The Wind
videos.overview: Sky feels guilty for causing Prapai to worry about him after a misleading phone call.

videos.title: When The Sky Surrenders To The Wind
videos.overview: A misunderstanding at a birthday party causes Sky to break things off with Prapai.

videos.title: The Wind Will Always Embrace The Sky
videos.overview: Sky's ex-boyfriend, Gun, returns to cause problems after he learns that Prapai and Sky are dating.
